title: Finn Fox's Whispering Wind
description: Finn Fox is frightened by the whistling nighttime wind until his mother shows him that the wind is just the forest singing its lullaby.
character_reference: a young bright red fox kit with an oversized fluffy white-tipped tail and big curious amber eyes

scenes.narration: Inside his cozy den, Finn pulled his wool blanket up over his pointy ears as the trees rattled outside.
scenes.visual: cozy underground burrow interior with straw bedding while dark shadows stretch across the dirt wall

scenes.narration: Whoosh went the wind through the high pine branches, sounding like a giant ghost sweeping through the dark.
scenes.visual: close-up of trembling whiskers and wide amber eyes staring anxiously toward the tunnel entrance

scenes.narration: His mother sat beside him, wrapping her warm bushy tail around his shoulders to help him feel safe.
scenes.visual: adult red fox gently nuzzling the younger kit inside a softly lit earthen den

scenes.narration: Listen closely, she whispered, tilting her head toward the rustling entrance.
scenes.visual: profile shot of two furry heads tilted upward in unison listening to distant sounds

scenes.narration: It is not a scary monster at all, but the wind singing a sleepy song to the sleeping forest.
scenes.visual: soft moonlight filtering down through pine needles onto quiet mossy ground outside

scenes.narration: Finn closed his eyes and listened again, hearing a sweet whistling tune instead of a frightening roar.
scenes.visual: peaceful sleepy expression with relaxed ears resting against soft straw bedding

scenes.narration: The world is full of music if we listen with a calm heart.
scenes.visual: wide peaceful shot of the cozy den entrance glowing warmly under a starlit sky

scenes.narration: Follow along for more gentle bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: warm glowing close-up of a friendly woodland creature waving happily toward the camera
